SELECT T1.calendar_id calendarId , T1.cdate cdate , T1.is_holiday isHoliday , T2.CALENDAR_NAME calendarName FROM MST_HOLIDAY T1 left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO T2 on T1.calendar_Id = T2.calendar_Id --01为法定节假日 WHERE T2.CALENDAR_ID ='01' AND to_char(T1.CDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') = #{analysisMdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.PORTFOLIO_ID id, m.PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO t INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO m ON t.PORTFOLIO_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID
and ( t.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') or m.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search}),'%') )
